title: ITE Students who Will Qualify for Entry into Polytechnics with New Grade Point Average Requirements
what_it_is: ITE Students who Will Qualify for Entry into Polytechnics with New Grade Point Average Requirements

sections.label: ITE to polytechnic GPA entry
sections.summary: About 4,000 ITE graduates are expected to qualify for polytechnic yearly, and those wanting unmapped courses may apply through the Early Admissions Exercise.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education (a) how many ITE students are estimated to be able to qualify per year under the new Grade Point Average requirements for entry into polytechnics; (b) what are the anticipated implications of these changes on polytechnic enrolment and respective programmes; and (c) how much flexibility is allowed for students to choose a polytechnic course which is not mapped to their current ITE course.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We expect the number of ITE progressors to polytechnics to remain stable with the revised MERs, as most Higher Nitec students admitted to the polytechnics today have a net GPA of 2.5 and above already.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: About 4,000 ITE graduates are expected to qualify for and progress to polytechnic each year, similar to today.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: ITE students who are interested to progress to a polytechnic diploma not mapped to their ITE course may apply through the Early Admissions Exercise (EAE).

sections.label: Career guidance and polytechnic flexibility
sections.summary: Career guidance is provided at ITE and polytechnic levels, and polytechnics are designing flexibility for students struggling in earlier semesters to take lighter loads.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: We do have career guidance for our students at the ITE level, even at the polytechnic level, to allow them to make informed decisions in terms of where and how they can get into a better course in the polytechnic.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: We have also been designing more flexibility at the polytechnic level to allow students some space, particularly those who are struggling in their earlier semesters, to allow them to take lighter loads so that they can cope with the demands of a polytechnic education.

sections.label: GPA 2.0 to 2.5 students
sections.summary: The group with GPA 2.0 to 2.5 is very small, and their polytechnic completion rates may not be as good as those with GPA 2.5 and above.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Given that the GPA has been increased from 2.0 to 2.5, each year, how many ITE students with a GPA of between 2.0 and 2.5 enrol in the polytechnics?

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Was there a study done into how they fare in their polytechnic studies?

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: The group of students with a GPA of 2.0 to 2.5 is very small.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: As it is, they apply to get in and, based on the number of places available, most who get admitted would already have gotten a GPA of 2.5 and above.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Those with a GPA of 2.0 to 2.5 do complete their polytechnic education, but we notice that their completion rates may not be as good as those with a GPA of 2.5 and above.
